text: {"features":[{"name":"Academic preparation","description":"How strongly the letter establishes advanced formal education relevant to computer science or closely related technical work.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"States a bachelor's degree in a relevant technical field and no stronger formal academic preparation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"States a bachelor's degree plus some additional formal technical study beyond the base degree, but no completed graduate degree."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"States a master's degree in computer science or a closely related technical field."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"States unusually advanced graduate preparation short of a completed doctorate, such as doctoral study or research-intensive specialization."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"States a completed doctorate in computer science or a closely related technical field."}]},{"name":"Production engineering experience","description":"How much the letter demonstrates hands-on experience testing, maintaining, and launching production software at meaningful scope.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Establishes only the low end of the sample's production background, such as roughly 3 years and a small number of launched services."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Shows a few years of production work with some launches and maintenance responsibility, but limited overall scope."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows solid mid-range production experience, often around 5 years or several launched services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong production experience with repeated launches, ongoing maintenance, and evidence of substantial service ownership."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows the top end of the sample's production background, such as roughly 7 years and many launched services under sustained ownership."}]},{"name":"Security automation motivation","description":"How clearly and convincingly the letter expresses motivation to reduce manual security toil through engineering and automation.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Expresses generic interest in security or software work without a clear focus on automating security processes."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions interest in security automation, but only briefly or in broad terms."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states that reducing manual security effort is a reason for applying, but with limited elaboration."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong, thoughtful motivation to automate security workflows and frames this as a central career interest."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Articulates a vivid, role-specific conviction about scaling scarce security judgment through automation and ties that conviction to the applicant's own experience."}]},{"name":"Platform impact orientation","description":"How strongly the letter shows a desire to build foundational systems whose impact compounds across many teams or products.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Says little about broad organizational impact and frames the role mostly as another engineering job."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions scale or infrastructure once, but without showing why that matters to the applicant."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly values work with organization-wide reach, though the point is stated more than developed."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Persuasively frames prior work and future goals around central tooling or infrastructure with multiplier effects."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes platform leverage a defining theme of the letter and explains why central security systems are especially compelling at Google's scale."}]},{"name":"Developer enablement mindset","description":"How strongly the letter frames security as helping product teams do the secure thing by default rather than adding friction after the fact.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not discuss how security work should serve or influence developer teams."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Hints at making security easier for others, but without clear developer-centered language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Explicitly says the applicant wants to help engineers build securely or embed security earlier in the lifecycle."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows a clear philosophy of security as enablement, with concrete language about reducing friction or assisting teams proactively."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Presents developer enablement as a core security principle and ties it directly to building defaults, tooling, or processes that busy engineers will actually use."}]},{"name":"Go backend depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates meaningful Go experience relevant to back-end or infrastructure engineering.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Mentions Go only briefly or incidentally, so depth is hard to judge."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Identifies Go as one of several languages but gives little evidence that it is the main production language."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Makes clear that Go is a regular language for production services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents Go as a primary or daily language tied to meaningful back-end or infrastructure work."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes Go central to the applicant's back-end profile, with repeated service ownership or architecture-level work in Go."}]},{"name":"Python depth","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates meaningful Python experience for services, automation, or tooling relevant to the role.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention Python or mentions it so vaguely that actual proficiency is unclear."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions Python briefly, with little indication of scope or type of work."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states regular Python use for relevant tasks such as services, tooling, or automation."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong Python fluency through daily or extensive use across several relevant contexts."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates deep, production-grade Python experience and explains how Python is used to power automation, internal services, or agent-related work."}]},{"name":"AI production experience","description":"How strongly the letter shows hands-on experience building or operating AI features in production settings.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention AI or only gestures at it without any evidence of hands-on work."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions AI or LLM exposure, but with limited clarity about what was built or whether it reached production."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states experience shipping AI-enabled or LLM-backed functionality."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes production AI work together with reliability, evaluation, or operational concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows deep applied AI experience by discussing shipped AI systems plus the safeguards, evaluation, or hardening needed to make them dependable."}]},{"name":"Agentic systems design","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates experience designing systems in which agents perform bounded multi-step work under software control.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention agents or autonomy-oriented system design."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions agentic or agent-based systems, but only at a high level."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly describes building agentic pipelines or tools with some indication of roles for agents and surrounding services."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Explains a concrete architecture in which agents act autonomously while other services constrain or observe them."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates sophisticated agentic design thinking, such as explicit boundaries, logging, permissions, guardrails, or end-to-end orchestration across Python agents and Go services."}]},{"name":"Vulnerability handling automation","description":"How strongly the letter shows direct experience automating vulnerability intake, triage, routing, deduplication, or related workflows.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any work on vulnerability-handling automation."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Expresses interest in vulnerability automation or alludes to related work without clear ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states that the applicant built tooling for vulnerability intake or triage."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a concrete vulnerability workflow the applicant automated, such as classification, deduplication, prioritization, or routing."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows especially strong alignment by describing a substantial transformation of vulnerability handling into a largely automated pipeline or by connecting the work to broader scaling goals such as variant analysis or workload reduction."}]},{"name":"Security assessment practice","description":"How strongly the letter shows direct experience performing structured security assessments of systems or designs.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no direct evidence of conducting security assessments."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Suggests some security review exposure, but without clear tasks or ownership."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Clearly states experience performing security assessments or reviews."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Specifies concrete assessment methods such as threat modeling, attack-surface analysis, code review, or remediation verification."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates mature assessment practice by combining multiple concrete methods with a clear builder-attacker perspective and follow-through on fixes."}]},{"name":"Data structures application","description":"How strongly the letter demonstrates real-world use of data structures and algorithms to improve system behavior.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention data structures or algorithms at all."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Claims strength or interest in algorithms, but offers little or no concrete example."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Gives a clear example of applying data structures or algorithms to a practical engineering problem."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Shows strong fluency through a concrete example on an important path, workflow, or system bottleneck."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates exceptional applied fluency by describing a nontrivial redesign in which a well-chosen structure or algorithm materially changed system tractability, performance, or correctness."}]},{"name":"External security signals","description":"How strongly the letter provides security depth signals outside normal job duties, such as rigorous certifications or sustained offensive practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Provides no meaningful external signal of hands-on security capability."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions a lighter signal, such as an entry-level certification or casual security practice."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows a solid external signal through recurring CTF participation, competitive finishes, or a basic certification paired with some practical framing."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Presents a strong external signal, such as a rigorous hands-on certification or serious competitive offensive practice."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Combines multiple strong signals, such as a practical offensive certification together with sustained high-level CTF performance or equally compelling external proof of security craft."}]},{"name":"Open-source involvement","description":"How strongly the letter shows contribution to or stewardship of open-source software relevant to the applicant's engineering practice.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any open-source involvement."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions occasional use-related patching or small contributions without ongoing responsibility."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Shows regular contribution behavior, such as submitting fixes upstream when issues are found."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes active stewardship, such as maintaining a library, reviewing contributions, or releasing software used beyond the applicant's own team."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Demonstrates substantial open-source leadership with sustained maintenance, external users, and clear responsibility for quality or community health."}]},{"name":"Independent project ambition","description":"How strongly the letter shows self-directed technical building outside assigned work, especially projects that surface hard engineering tradeoffs.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Does not mention any meaningful independent technical project."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Mentions only a small or routine side project with limited technical ambition."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Describes a modest but real self-built project that shows initiative and some end-to-end ownership."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Describes a technically substantial personal project, often involving infrastructure, reliability, or distributed-systems concerns."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Shows exceptional self-directed ambition through a demanding project chosen specifically to wrestle with hard systems problems, failure modes, or tradeoffs."}]},{"name":"Specificity of evidence","description":"How concretely the letter supports its claims with observable examples, details, or outcomes rather than generic assertions.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Relies mostly on broad claims about ability or fit with little concrete support."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Includes a few specifics, but most claims remain generic or weakly evidenced."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Supports several important claims with concrete examples or details."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Consistently grounds qualifications in specific work, technologies, or outcomes."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Makes the case almost entirely through crisp, concrete evidence, with multiple specific examples that make the applicant's claims easy to trust."}]},{"name":"Narrative coherence","description":"How well the letter forms a clear, cohesive story about the applicant's background and why this role is the logical next step.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Reads as a disconnected list of qualifications or sentiments with little through-line."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Has some structure, but the connection between past experience and this role remains loose."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Presents a reasonably clear case for fit, even if the story is mostly straightforward."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Builds a coherent professional arc that links prior experience, present interests, and the target role."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Delivers a memorable, well-integrated narrative in which the applicant's experiences, motivations, and target role reinforce one another throughout."}]},{"name":"Writing polish","description":"How free the letter is from distracting spelling, grammar, usage, or formatting errors.","levels":[{"score":1,"descriptor":"Contains frequent mechanical errors that repeatedly distract and materially weaken professionalism."},{"score":2,"descriptor":"Contains multiple noticeable errors that interrupt reading but do not fully obscure meaning."},{"score":3,"descriptor":"Contains some errors, yet remains generally readable and professionally serviceable."},{"score":4,"descriptor":"Is mostly clean, with only minor isolated errors or awkwardness."},{"score":5,"descriptor":"Is polished and nearly error-free, reading as careful professional communication."}]}]}
